payload.description: The council published turnout for each ward in 2023 but not in 2024, 2025 or 2026, so turnout is missing for the more recent elections. Majorities are worked out from the council's own vote counts: the winner's votes minus the best-placed candidate who did not win a seat.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
